 BOISE — Counsel for Lori Vallow Daybell argued Monday before the Idaho Supreme Court that the removal of their client’s chosen attorney for her 2023 murder trial was a constitutional violation that should merit the overturning of her convictions.
 Alongside her husband, Chad Daybell, Vallow Daybell was convicted in Idaho of the murders of her children, Tylee Ryan and JJ Vallow, and of Daybell’s first wife, Tammy, all of which took place in 2019 before the couple married.
